verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev supports GitHub Actions deployment on push to main, environment-scoped API keys/management client for dev/staging/prod, and env management CLI commands, which together enable versioning and promotion workflows. However there's no explicit docs on rollback, environment promotion approval gates, or diffing workflow versions across environments. Missing for 10: dedicated environment-promotion/rollback documentation, explicit versioned workflow diffing across environments, and independent evidence of teams using this promotion flow in production.
